content: Two distinct GH Actions caches: (1) Turbo task cache via dtinth/setup-github-actions-caching-for-turbo (TURBO_API/TOKEN backed by GH cache, no Vercel) for turbo run lint typecheck test; (2) Docker layer cache via docker/build-push-action cache-from/to type=gha,mode=max,scope=<app>. GH cache API v1 shut down Apr 2025; only v2 (current build-push-action v6/v7, buildx v3/v4). GHCR: login-action with GITHUB_TOKEN, permissions packages:write, metadata-action for sha+latest tags.
